blocks.text: Optical isomers ek doosre ki aisi aaina (mirror) shakalein hain jo ek doosre par poori tarah nahi baithtin (non-superimposable). Optical isomerism aam tor par bidentate ligands wale octahedral complexes dikhate hain. Misal: nickel(II) ka complex jis mein 1,2-diaminoethane (NH₂CH₂CH₂NH₂) bidentate ligand hai (Figure 18.13). Is ke do isomers ek doosre ki aaina shakal hain aur ek doosre par nahi baithte, is liye optical isomers hain; aise jore ko enantiomers kehte hain. Optical isomers polarized light ke plane ko ulti simton mein ghumate hain: jo daen (right) taraf ghumaye woh dextrorotatory "+" aur jo baen (left) taraf ghumaye woh laevorotatory "–" kehlata hai.

blocks.alt: Dashed aaine ki lakeer ke dono taraf [Ni(en)3]2+ ki do aaina shakalein. Har aik mein chhe N atoms Ni ke gird hain aur har N se Ni ki taraf teer (dative bond) hai; N atoms joron mein CH2-CH2 zanjeeron se jure hain, aik jora oopar, aik pehlu mein aur aik neeche; pehlu wala jora aik shakal mein daen aur doosri mein baen hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.13: [Ni(en)₃]²⁺ ke do optical isomers jo ek doosre par nahi baithte (kitab ki Figure 18.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har en ligand (H₂N–CH₂–CH₂–NH₂) apne do N atoms se Ni ko pakarta hai, is liye teen en mil kar chhe bonds banate hain (octahedral). Dono shakalein ek doosre ki aaina shakal hain; inhein kitna bhi ghumayein, ek doosre par poori nahi baithtin, isi liye yeh enantiomers hain.

blocks.prompt: a) Kaun si geometries cis-trans isomerism dikhati hain?
b) Complex ke optical isomerism dikhane ke liye aksar kis qism ka ligand chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Octahedral complex mein bidentate ligand (jaise en).

blocks.prompt: c) [Ni(en)₃]²⁺ ke liye coordination number aur ligand ki qism batayein.
blocks.explanation: Coordination number 6 (teen en, har ek do bonds); en bidentate ligand hai.

blocks.prompt: d) [Ni(NH₂CH₂CH₂NH₂)₃]²⁺ kaun si isomerism dikhata hai, aur dono isomers plane-polarized light par kya asar karte hain?
blocks.explanation: Optical isomerism; dono enantiomers polarized light ke plane ko barabar miqdar mein ulti simton mein ghumate hain: ek (+) daen aur doosra (–) baen.

blocks.prompt: e) Optical isomers (enantiomers) ki taareef mirror image aur superimposability ke hawale se karein.
blocks.explanation: Yeh ek doosre ki mirror images hain jo ek doosre par superimpose nahi ho saktin (poori nahi baithtin).

items: Optical isomers: mirror images jo ek doosre par na baithein (enantiomers).
Bidentate ligands wale octahedral complexes, maslan [Ni(en)₃]²⁺.
